breakdown.description: It asks for the subsurface carbon content to reach 1.10 wt% C even though the surface is held at only 0.90 wt% C. A concentration inside the solid cannot exceed the imposed constant surface concentration in this setup.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly changed the desired carbon content at 0.6 mm depth from 1.10 wt% C (which would be physically impossible since it exceeds the surface concentration of 0.90 wt% C) to 0.60 wt% C, matching the ground truth prompt.
